hero.eyebrow: Founded in Chicago. Built for Illinois. Growing Nationwide.
hero.subtext: Founded in Chicago and expanding statewide, BCOE unites Black contractors, owners, and executives to unlock contracts, build partnerships, and create lasting economic impact across Illinois — with a vision to grow nationwide.

about.label: Who We Are
about.title: More Than an Organization — A Movement
about.subtitle: BCOE is a premier Black business consortium founded in Chicago and proudly serving professionals across Illinois. We empower businesses through strategic partnerships, innovative solutions, and a commitment to excellence — with a vision to expand our impact nationwide.
about.missionQuote: Our mission is to promote economic growth and advancement in Black communities through education, mentoring, advocacy, and legislation — unifying our community across Illinois and providing the resources necessary for success, with eyes on national expansion.

pillars.title: Education & Training
pillars.text: Access workshops, seminars, and professional development resources designed for contractors and construction professionals.

pillars.title: Strategic Mentorship
pillars.text: Connect with seasoned industry leaders who open doors, share knowledge, and invest in your success.

pillars.title: Advocacy & Legislation
pillars.text: We lobby for equitable policies and opportunities ensuring Black contractors compete on a level playing field.

pillars.title: Contract Opportunities
pillars.text: Members gain access to a pipeline of public and private sector contracts, bids, and partnership opportunities.

items.title: Elite Network Access
items.text: Connect with influential decision-makers, state officials, and corporate partners driving construction and business opportunities across Illinois and beyond.

items.title: Visibility & Credibility
items.text: Membership signals your commitment to excellence. Get featured in our directory, events, and marketing reaching thousands of stakeholders.

items.title: Business Development
items.text: Monthly meetings, pitch opportunities, and curated introductions designed to generate real business — not just business cards.

items.title: Community Impact
items.text: Every dollar you invest in membership strengthens Black economic power across Illinois and builds a legacy for the next generation.

cdiTeaser.description: BCOE now offers a full Education Series — three programs taught by industry partners to give Black contractors the operational knowledge, business systems, and strategic edge they need to win larger work.

joinBand.title: Join BCOE Today
joinBand.text: Become part of a growing statewide network of Black contractors and business professionals driving real economic change across Illinois — and beyond.
